notes.title: OST Behind-the-Scenes and demo playthrough - AdventureX 2023
notes.notes:
[i]The Season of the Warlock[/i] is taking part once again in the AdventureX Steam event, November 3 - 9, and this time we’re not only streaming the demo playthrough, but also a behind-the-scenes video of our original soundtrack. Presented by our talented composer, Carlos M. Jara, you’ll be able to watch and hear our orchestra play, as well as listen to some themes not present in the demo.

For last year’s AdventureX event we made too many announcements, which we agree were probably annoying for those of your following us, so this will be the only one this year, but we’ll leave the broadcast on repeat since 7 PM CET today, and restart it following this schedule:

[list]
[*]Saturday 4 - 12 PM CET
[*]Sunday 5 - 12 PM CET
[*]Monday 6 - 8 AM CET
[*]Tuesday 7 - 1 AM CET
[*]Wednesday 8 - 8 PM CET
[*]Thursday 9 - 12 AM CET
[/list]

Remember the demo is public and you can play it yourselves. Wishlist the game, and spread the word!

Last but not least, check out the sale and play some other great demos!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/AdventureX2023]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/AdventureX2023[/url]

notes.title: Check out the first teaser for the weird adventure The Season of the Warlock
notes.notes:
The Season of the Warlock, a brand new point and click adventure from developer enComplot has been announced with a teaser and it looks really good.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/04/check-out-the-first-teaser-for-the-weird-adventure-the-season-of-the-warlock
